import logging

import anthropic

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
RETRYABLE = {429, 500, 503, 529}


def request():
    return {"model": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "max_tokens": 2048}


async def call(client):
    # Retry-After is respected between attempts.
    message = await client.messages.create(**request())
    if message.stop_reason == "refusal":
        return None
    logger.info("length=%d", len(message.content))
    return message
